campaign_manifest.design: same-cohort runtime repeat; A/B/B/A; no new holdout

effects.limitation: Temporal association and per-arm identity matching do not isolate a counterfactual cost of one preemption event.

work.semantics: Work counts use only successful engine calls and overlap with previously executed request-position intervals. Recomputed generated history is not new decoding. Work is already inside full host request time.

held.scope: Decision CPU wall time excludes subsequent native scheduling and checks; already included in request wall time. Held step counts are not durations or GPU time.

preemption_events.hook_boundary: Caller already removed victim from running; see schedule-before snapshot.
Caller already removed victim from running; see schedule-before snapshot.

repeated_preemption.scope: Consecutive successful native preemptions of the same request; no new generated token between events. Not all recomputation is wasted work.

source.selection_rule: next32 complete articles with >=3072 tokens after all96 prior row intervals, in pinned shard source order; exclude duplicate document and prompt-prefix hashes
source.pre_run_length_rationale: 3072 prompt +1024 output retains active requests longer while later long prefills are admitted; 3968+128 could drain before 32 requests become active. This is regime qualification, chosen before GPU results.
source.reconstruction_rule: concatenate original row strings exactly from one top-level title to before the next; no added separators
source.identity_scope: Document, row and prompt-prefix disjoint from original32 and holdout cohort0/1 (96 prior requests); same dataset, lengths and steady-arrival regime, not an independent population.

config.input_preparation: offline fresh32 prefix inputs; GPU UNRUN; inherited SLO fields are reference only
config.metric_role: continuous request metrics primary; SLO 5s/.2s reference only

scope: Same previously observed cohort2, native/most then most/native, four fresh engines. This is an exploratory runtime repeat, not a fresh-document holdout. Retain all calls, including long calls. No cache reset, pressure warmup, drift subtraction, significance, noise bound, quality equivalence or method GO.
pairing_rule: All four must qualify; native/most per block, never replace or correct baseline.
cost_scope: Full wall retained; scheduler inclusive + engine non schedule + outside engine; no long-call subtraction.
